cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12.4)

project(RpmPackageManager_unit_test)

file(GLOB RPM_UNIT_TEST_SRC "*.cpp")
file(GLOB RPM_SRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../src/packages/rpm*.cpp")

add_executable(Rpm_unit_test ${RPM_UNIT_TEST_SRC} ${RPM_SRC})

# Includes rpm headers generated by the rpm build; without this, a parallel build can compile it
# before rpm_external has produced them when the precompiled rpm library is unavailable.
if(TARGET rpm_external)
  add_dependencies(Rpm_unit_test rpm_external)
endif()

target_link_libraries(
  Rpm_unit_test
  debug
  gtestd
  debug
  gmockd
  debug
  gtest_maind
  debug
  gmock_maind
  optimized
  gtest
  optimized
  gmock
  optimized
  gtest_main
  optimized
  gmock_main
  pthread
  sqlite3
  cjson
  proc
  dl)

add_test(NAME Rpm_unit_test COMMAND Rpm_unit_test)

set_tests_properties(Rpm_unit_test PROPERTIES LABELS "data_provider")
